comments.author: Claudia
comments.body: What can I get from this ticket???

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
You get this as a reward for investing in certain ports for every certain amount. You get one of the following:

Purchase Order (Category 1) x 1
Purchase Order (Category 2) x 1
Purchase Order (Category 3) x 1
Purchase Order (Category 4) x 1
Smoke Bomb x 2
Landmark Ribbon x 2
Couscous x 1
Quest Mediation Permit x 1
Calming Flag x 2
Request Investment Book x 1
Shipwreck Map Piece x 1
